methodologyNotes: Dataset covers twelve high-search juicer models spanning centrifugal, masticating (single-auger/vertical), and twin-gear categories. Each price and headline spec was independently re-verified on 2026-06-19 against manufacturer product pages (breville.com, omegajuicers.com, hurom.com, namawell.com, tribest.com, kuvingsusa.com, aicookhome.com), authorized retailer pages (Target, Walmart, Extreme Wellness Supply, Harvest Essentials, Advanced Mixology), and the Hurom PR Newswire H400 launch release. Weights are in pounds (lb); feed_chute_in is the chute opening diameter in decimal inches; motor_watts and rpm are unitless integers or string ranges where dual-speed ranges apply; dishwasher_safe_parts is a boolean (true = at least the main removable juicing parts are dishwasher-safe per manufacturer); warranty_years is the longest stated coverage (motor coverage where motor and parts differ). Prices are US MSRP or current listed retail price in USD as of accessedAt 2026-06-19. Corrections this pass: (1) Mueller centrifugal model was mislabeled 'MU-100' — the real model number is SD80A (per kitchencritics.com and product EAN); slug/name/provenance corrected, no MU-100 product exists. (2) Nama J2 release year '2024' could not be corroborated to any specific year (J1 ~2021, J2 reviewed from ~2022-2023) so releaseDate and the release spec were nulled (a null beats a guess). All other prices and headline specs corroborated from primary or reputable retailer sources.

products.name: Juice Fountain Cold Plus
products.priceNote: Current retail price at Target ($329.99); Breville.com lists $329.95 MSRP
products.provenance: Breville.com confirms $329.95 MSRP and 3.5-inch extra-wide chute; Target lists $329.99 and confirms 1000W motor, 2 speeds, dishwasher-safe parts, and 13.7 lb weight. Warranty is 1 year on parts with 5-year motor coverage; warranty_years set to 5 (motor). RPM not published by Breville for this centrifugal model (left null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Juice Fountain Elite
products.provenance: breville.com directly confirms $299.95, 1000W motor, max 13,000 RPM (half-speed 6,500), and 3-inch extra-wide chute. Weight 14.4 lb from multiple review sources. Warranty 1 year per Breville US. Dishwasher-safe parts (cover, filter bowl, puree disc, juice jug). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: NC900HDC Nutrition Center
products.priceNote: Current Walmart listing price; omegajuicers.com showed $199.99 sale (regular $429.95)
products.provenance: omegajuicers.com confirms 150W, 80 RPM, 15-year warranty, all removable parts top-rack dishwasher safe, and 18.7 lb weight (page showed $199.99 sale from $429.95). Walmart lists $349.99; used as priceUsd. Feed chute diameter not published on verified pages (null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: MM900HDS Cold Press Celery Juicer
products.provenance: omegajuicers.com directly confirms $359.95, 200W, 80 RPM, 15-year warranty, and 14.08 lb weight. Dishwasher-safe (top rack) per manual/retailer listings. Feed chute exact diameter not specified on any verified page (null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: H-AA Slow Juicer
products.provenance: hurom.com directly confirms $399, 150W, 43 RPM auger, 50mm (2-inch) feed chute, 8.3 kg (18.2 lb) weight, and 10-year motor warranty (2-year parts). Release year 2016 from Amazon ASIN first-listed date. Dishwasher-safe false: Hurom states only the auger is dishwasher safe, not all parts. Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: H400 Easy Clean Slow Juicer
products.priceNote: Current sale price on hurom.com (regular $749); launched at $549 in March 2023
products.provenance: hurom.com confirms 150W, 90 RPM, 45mm (1.8-inch) hopper, 6.7 kg (14.8 lb), 15-year motor+parts warranty, and current price $669 (sale from $749). PR Newswire release confirms March 22, 2023 launch at $549. Dishwasher-safe false per Hurom (only auger). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: J2 Cold Press Juicer
products.provenance: namawell.com directly confirms $599, 200W rated power, 50 RPM, 12.1 lb weight, and 15-year warranty. releaseDate nulled: '2024' could not be corroborated — the J1 dates to ~2021 and the J2 was reviewed from ~2022-2023, so no specific launch year is reliably attestable (null beats a guess). Feed chute not specified (wide-mouth hopper design). Dishwasher-safe status not explicitly confirmed (null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Greenstar Elite GSE-5000
products.provenance: tribest.com directly confirms $599.95, 200W, 110 RPM, 1.5-inch diameter chute, 12-year household-use warranty, and 16 lb product weight (27 lb package). Higher weights seen at some retailers reflect package/shipping weight; used manufacturer 16 lb figure. Dishwasher-safe juicing components per GSE-series. Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: CJE-1000P1 Juice Extractor
products.priceNote: Current retail price at Target; Cuisinart.com lists $229.95
products.provenance: Target confirms $229.99, 3-inch feed tube, 14.11 lb weight, 3-year limited warranty, and dishwasher-safe parts. The Target spec field shows '300 watts' which is a known data error — Cuisinart's own documentation and multiple retail sources confirm 1000W (5-speed die-cast model). RPM not published by Cuisinart (null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Whole Slow Juicer B6000
products.priceNote: Current price at Extreme Wellness Supply and kuvingsusa.com
products.provenance: Extreme Wellness Supply confirms $399.95, 240W, 60 RPM, 3-inch wide-mouth chute, and 10-year warranty. Amazon B6000SR listing also confirms 60 RPM and 10-year warranty. Weight_lb 14 reflects manufacturer product weight (retailer shows 18 lb shipping weight). Dishwasher-safe false per review sources stating hand-wash. Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Ultra Juicer SD80A
products.provenance: Model corrected: draft labeled this 'MU-100', but the real Mueller Austria Ultra 1100W model number is SD80A (per kitchencritics.com and product EAN 5060554560608); no 'MU-100' SKU exists. advancedmixology.com and kitchencritics.com confirm 1100W, dual-speed 12,000-15,000 (low) and 15,000-18,000 (high) RPM, 3-inch chute, and 2-year warranty. Price $69.97 per kitchencritics.com (advancedmixology showed a $149.49 sale price). Dishwasher-safe parts excluding motor base. Product weight not reliably published (2.2 lb Amazon figure is a data error); set null. Re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Slow Masticating Juicer AMR521
products.provenance: aicookhome.com (official brand site) page loads and confirms $129.99 sale (regular $219.99), 150W, 80 RPM, 45mm (~1.8-inch) feed chute, dishwasher-safe parts, and 1-year warranty. AMR521 is a real budget masticating juicer also listed on eBay/Mercari/Belk. Product weight not published on verified pages (null). Re-verified 2026-06-19.
